agt_notes: AGT has no cron/scheduled jobs: every recurring job runs as a loop inside this deployment (deploy/agt/scheduler.py).
AGT deploys accept GitHub URLs only; this manifest targets the public repo on branch main.
The deployment must operate independently: the development agent's computer does not need to remain online.

Secrets mapping: deploy/agt/secrets_mapping.md. Storage budget: deploy/agt/storage_budget.md. Backup + restore drill: deploy/agt/backup_recovery.md. Upgrade + rollback: deploy/agt/upgrade_rollback.md.
